title: Mkpụrụ obi nke ire dị nsọ nyefere
intro: Tupu ị gbaa akụkọ banyere obi ike pụrụ iche, ebe otu onye nwara ịgbagha nkwenkwe ndị kacha gbanye mkpọrọgwụ n'ime mmepeanya dum. Soro okwu ndị a sitere n'oge gara aga, ị ga-achọpụta ndụ nke okwukwe na-adịghị agbanwe agbanwe, nlanarị ọrụ ebube, na ịtọ ntọala nke ga-akpụzi njem ime mmụọ nke ọtụtụ ijeri mmadụ. Chọpụta ihe ọ bụla e ji amata - ọkụ dị nsọ ka na-echeta.
clues: A mụrụ m n'ezinụlọ nke na-asọpụrụ ihe ndị dị n'eluigwe na ihe ndị a kpụrụ akpụ, mana ihe dị n'ime m jụrụ ihe ha na-efe.
Eguzogidere m onye ọchịchị kachasị ike n'ala m, tipịasịa arụsị ndị m kpọọrọ isiala nye, ma kwupụta na ọ bụ naanị Onye Okike nke eluigwe kwesịrị nsọpụrụ.
E nyere iwu ka e jiri aha m kpọọ ọkụ, mana m kwupụtara na Onye m na-ejere ozi naanị ya ga-azọpụta m — e wee nye iwu ka ọkụ ahụ dị jụụ ma dị nchebe.
Ahapụkwara m ihe niile m maara nke ọma n'iwu Chineke, na-agagharị na ndagwurugwu kpọrọ nkụ na ezinụlọ m, na-atụkwasị obi n'ihe m na-ahụbeghị.
Anyị guzo n'akụkụ nwa m nwoke mbụ n'ime ndagwurugwu tọgbọrọ chakoo, anyị wulitere ntọala ụlọ nsọ, ebe nsọ nke a kara aka maka ndị niile na-erubere isi.
A maara m dị ka Khalilullah — enyi nke Onye Kasị Ebere — aha m aghọkwara ihe jikọtara ya na okwukwe nke inyefe onwe na inyefe onwe.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Onye Amụma Ibrahim (Abraham)
Onye Amụma Mozis (Moses)
Onye Amụma Noa (Noa)
Onye Amụma Aịza (Jizọs)
Onye amuma Muhammad ﷺ

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịbụ onye ọchịchị aka ike tụbara n'ime ọkụ na-ere ọkụ
A na-elo ya n'ime nnukwu azụ̀ n'oké osimiri
Ụmụnna ekworo na-eweda ha n'ime olulu
A na-ebuga ya n'elu n'elu ihe e kere eke nwere nku
Ịnagide nnukwu idei mmiri n'ime ite osisi
trial.answer: Ịbụ onye ọchịchị aka ike tụbara n'ime ọkụ na-ere ọkụ

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Ụlọ Nsọ (Kaaba)
Nnukwu arịa osisi e wuru n'elu ugwu
Mkpanaka nke nwere ike ịgbawa oké osimiri
Ọgba nke ụra ogologo oge ya na nkịta kwesịrị ntụkwasị obi
Akwụkwọ mpịakọta nke iwu e kpughere ekpughe nke e tinyere n'elu ugwu

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: A maara ya dịka Khalilullah, enyi Allah nke ọma
Duru ndị mmadụ gafee oké osimiri kewara ekewa ruo ebe nchekwa
E nyere ya ikike ịchịkwa ifufe na ike ndị a na-adịghị ahụ anya
Aghọrọ m onye na-agwọ ọrịa nke e ji ọgwụgwọ ọrụ ebube gwọọ
Ebo iri na abụọ gbasaara agbasasị jikọtara ọnụ n'otu ọgbụgba ndụ
outcome.answer: A maara ya dịka Khalilullah, enyi Allah nke ọma

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
